annotations.title: Check or cancel an SEC alert subscription (free)

description: Free, no payment needed. Give the `subscription_id` and `signing_secret` from sec_alert_subscription to see whether it is active, when it expires, how many alerts were delivered and the last delivery error, or set `cancel: true` to stop deliveries (no refund).
